info.title: AKAC Reference Admin and SCIM API
info.description: Operator-facing API on its own listener (default port 8788). Credentials are administrator identities bound to a tenant and an admin actor; agent credentials are rejected and admin credentials are rejected on the agent listener. Authority is the admin actor's standing role (security-admin, kb-admin, auditor), enforced and audited on every call. The tenant always comes from the credential. Exactly one authentication mode is configured: opaque tokens (SHA-256 digested) or verified at+jwt with an audience distinct from the agent API. Limits are per process.

put.summary: Create or replace a role (acyclic hierarchy, depth limit)
put.description: Requires the standing role security-admin. Tenant comes from the credential; a body tenant or id, if present, must match. A new role, new juniors or a reactivation that would put a currently valid active principal into a static separation-of-duty violation is 409 SOD_VIOLATION with `holders` (a count, never ids). Deactivation and removing juniors always succeed.

put.summary: Create or replace a separation-of-duty constraint
put.description: Requires the standing role security-admin. Tenant comes from the credential; a body tenant or id, if present, must match. A static constraint that currently valid active principals would violate is 409 SOD_VIOLATION with `holders` (a count, never ids); resolve the assignments first. Dynamic constraints and relaxations are not checked against holders.

delete.summary: Retire a document (and remove its index entries when an ingestor is wired)
delete.description: Requires the standing role kb-admin (with or without an ingestor). Marks the document inactive and advances the tenant epoch, so running contexts that read it must re-establish authority. Only documents: memory and artifacts are revoked with POST /admin/v1/revocations (security-admin).

post.summary: Issue a root or attenuated run grant
post.description: Requires security-admin. `Idempotency-Key` replays the stored response for an identical body; a different body under the same key is 422. The store is an in-memory LRU per administrator and per instance. A replay is re-authorized (403 if the administrator no longer holds security-admin) and audited as IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY; key reuse is audited as a denial.

idempotent-replayed.description: true when replayed from the idempotency store

post.summary: Repair drift between the store and the vector index for the caller's tenant
post.description: Requires the standing role kb-admin (audited as index_reconcile). Re-indexes documents whose version, label digest or embedding model differs and removes chunks of inactive, expired or deleted documents. Scans at most 5000 documents; `truncated` reports a capped scan. Returns 404 when vector retrieval is not configured.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque administrator token (at least 32 characters) or an at+jwt for the admin audience.

XRequestId.description: Server-generated request id, also present in logs. A client-supplied value is ignored.

holders.description: SOD_VIOLATION from a role or constraint change only: how many currently valid principals the change would invalidate. Identities are never returned.

origin.description: Model-origin content enters only through derive().

ScimExtension.description: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:akac:2.0:User. clearance and projects apply to users; roles to groups.

ScimUserRequest.description: Profile attributes beyond those listed are accepted and discarded; roles, groups and entitlements are rejected.
